Our artists create the impossible on screen every day. Behind the scenes, we need someone equally sharp making sure the numbers that power it all are accurate, timely, and telling the right story. About The Role This is a hands-on Commercial Accountant position sitting at the heart of our finance function. You'll own the day-to-day financial rhythm of the business payroll, cashflow forecasting, revenue recognition, management accounts, accounts payable, and more. It's operational, it's fast, and no two weeks look exactly the same. You'll work closely with our Senior Leadership Team, Production team, wider crew and be our day-to-day contact with our external accountants. What You'll Own Monthly payroll end-to-end via Smartly, including contractor payments and compliance 90-day rolling cashflow forecast in Xero, reported weekly to the leadership team Weekly revenue roll call reporting in collaboration with the Production team Monthly management accounts including P&L, budget variance, and balance sheet Accounts payable - invoice processing, coding, and payment batches Client and supplier invoicing tied to project milestones Daily bank and credit card reconciliations Day-to-day relationship with our external accountants Annual R&D tax credit coordination Contractor onboarding, compliance, and scheduled payments Requirements What We're Actually Looking For Someone who's done this before, ideally in a fast-paced, scale up environment where you've had to be adaptable, wear multiple hats, and figure things out without a playbook. You're not waiting to be asked. You flag things early, share information openly, and understand that in a business like ours, finance exists to serve the wider team not the other way around. Technically, you'll need: 5+ years of accounting or commercial finance experience End-to-end payroll experience (NZ and ideally Australian contractor compliance) Xero and Smartly proficiency Strong Excel skills and a solid grasp of NZ bookkeeping, GST, and employment compliance Understanding of revenue recognition including percentage-completion accounting (bonus points if you've worked in a project-based or creative environment) What It's Like Here We move fast, are solution focussed and take full ownership in anything we do. We back each other up, and we take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. We're in the office three days a week minimum. We're based in Auckland. Benefits Health and wellness allowance Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) Access to ongoing learning & development Regular social events and a team that genuinely enjoys spending time together A front-row seat to how a creative business runs with real visibility and real impact Interested? We are defined by our people".

review_candidates.title: Auxiliar de Produção Cuiabá - MT - MT
review_candidates.description: A Mirandex começou sua história em meados de 1994, ainda como distribuidora de Vidros Brasil de Rondônia, atuando no ramo de distribuição de chapas e vidros em comum. Em 1998, começou a procura pelo vidro temperado no Estado, o que ainda era uma novidade. Desde então, começamos a revender o vidro temperado que era produzido nos grandes centros do país. O aumento da demanda, a dificuldade de compra e transporte, além do prazo de entrega, fizeram com que nos inspirássemos a montar uma indústria própria. Então em 2000, inauguramos nossa indústria de vidro temperado, a primeira do estado de Rondônia, com forno de têmpera verticial. Cada vez mais aquecido, o mercado exigia novos produtos e mais rapidez de entrega. Visando isso, em 2002 demos um grande passo ao adquirir um forno horizontal de tecnologia americana, que produzia vidros com mais rapidez e qualidade. Dessa forma, a Mirandex se torna a maior empresa do ramo vidraceiro da região Norte do Brasil. Suas principais atividades serão: Auxilia no processo industrial, transportar vidros e organizar peças, Trabalhar na área de produção , montando caixas, suprindo a demanda da indústria . Auxiliar no preparo de materiais para linhas de produção, Organiza a área de serviço Abastece linhas de produção Alimenta máquinas Separa materiais para reaproveitamento. Para esta posição esperamos de você: Organização Agilidade Comunicação eficaz Resistência física Trabalho em equipe Beneficios: Vale alimentação Seguro de vida Adiantamento Salarial Prêmio de assiduidade Vale Transporte conforme necessidade do trabalhador Acesso a curso plataforma solides Tem um time incrivel te esperando! Formação Acadêmica Não informado Salário A combinar Cargo Auxiliar de produção Empresa MIRANDEX REFERENCIA EM VIDROS Fabricação de vidro plano e de segurança. Ramo Industrial (CD)

review_candidates.title: Associate Product Definition Analyst
review_candidates.description: Job Title Associate Product Definition Analyst About Your Business Area/Department Airline Operations oversees applications that support airlines, agents, and passengers throughout the travel experience. Within this department, our team is building the next generation of the Departure Control System—a modern platform designed to streamline customer management. It will empower agents and enable passengers to self-serve through intuitive digital solutions, delivering a seamless, efficient, and reliable experience that enhances every stage of the journey. Summary Of The Role We are on the lookout for a Product Definition Analyst. As a PDA your mission is to analyze, design and specify the best functional solution for our Delivery Management system, along with a detailed test plan and specifications, always focused on providing the best travel experience to our customers. Works autonomously within defined processes and procedures or methodologies, takes standard decisions and may support the development of solutions to complex problems of a recurring nature. In this role you’ll Build, maintain and share the functional knowledge of our processes, services and usage of end user products. Analyze business requirements submitted by Product Management. Size specification and validation work. Carry out functional design Write Feasibility Studies, Solution Overview Documents, Interface Control Documents, Product Specifications and present functional walk-throughs to all concerned stakeholders. Interface with relevant divisions and departments to identify interactions with other Amadeus applications and ensure functional compatibility. Overview validation Contribute to the implementation of the test strategy, and review test plan, to ensure compliance of the delivered functionality and system integrity Ensure traceability of tests with specifications Ensure production integrity by investigating, validating and prioritizing reported incidents. Manage relations with key stakeholders Interface and communicate with Product Management, Project management Interface with the customer during requirements understanding, functional specification, testing and implementation phases. Participate to team events Support team stakeholders by participating in team ceremonies: Agile forums, Team meetings, Solution assessments. About The Ideal Candidate Has 3+ years progressive work-related experience with demonstrated proficiency in multiple disciplines/processes including travel industry experience analytics, and/or product development experience. Has strong communication skills (written and verbal). Has strong organizational skills with a high attention to detail. Ability to write clear and structured documentation Has the ability to analyze objectives, considers options and plans. Has experience with JIRA. Has previous exposure to SAFe agile. What We Can Offer You Get rewarded with competitive remuneration, individual and company annual bonus, vacation and holiday paid time off, health insurances and other competitive benefits. Work hybrid at our Bogota office. Professional development to broaden your knowledge and enhance your skills with on-line learning hubs packed with technical and soft skills training that allow you to develop and grow. Enter a diverse and inclusive workplace, join one of the world’s top travel technology companies and take on a role that impacts millions of travelers around the globe. Application process The application process takes no longer than 10 minutes! Create your candidate profile, upload your Resume/CV and apply today! Working at Amadeus, you will find 🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose. 🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture. 🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues. 🤗 A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment. 💰 A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive remuneration packages, covering all essential components of a competitive reward offer, including salary, bonus, equity, and benefits. 🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization. 📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees. Diversity & Inclusion Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience. Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law. Be aware of recruitment scams Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.
